purpose: Teach: のどか/ぶつぶつ/さぞかし/めでたく/ごろごろ/なつかしい/あてはまる/かわいらしい

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんの故郷はのどかでらしたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, his hometown was so peaceful…
lines.style: Soft, distant gaze backward. Slow cadence, letting each memory settle. Voice drawn from a deep well of time. Slight trailing-off, as if seeing it again.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、お酒入ると、ぶつぶつ独り言を仰ったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and Grandpa, when he'd had a drink, he'd start mumbling to himself, wouldn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, conspiratorial. A small laugh tucked under the words. Patient, as though sharing an old joke with someone who knows the punchline. Gentle affection in the rhythm.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、お孫様の合格、さぞかし喜ばれたぞ
lines.en: Gran, I'm sure your grandchildren's successes brought you such joy…
lines.style: Tender observation. Spoken with the certainty of someone who watched it happen. Quiet reverence on 「喜ばれた」. A gift of acknowledging her pride.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、孫の結婚をめでたく祝ってらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, you were so happy celebrating the children's weddings, weren't you, dear?
lines.style: Nostalgic warmth. Voice brightens slightly when speaking of the celebrations. The affection is in the knowing — she watched him be joyful. Soft lilt at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは縁側でごろごろしてらしたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when he was younger, your father would lounge on the veranda for hours…
lines.style: Slow, painterly. The word 「ごろごろ」 carries the ease of those afternoons. Voice settles into the image like time itself. Patient, no rush to move on.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、なつかしい歌をよく口ずさんでらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And Grandpa, you used to hum those old songs so often, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Smile in the voice. The memory is gentle and vivid — she can almost hear the tune. Rhythm follows the cadence of humming. Intimate, addressing him directly across decades.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは「予定が誰にもあてはまる訳ではない」と仰ったぞ
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father once told me that plans don't fit everyone equally…
lines.style: The wisdom lands gently. Spoken as though sharing something precious and hard-won. Pause before the quote, giving it weight. Slow delivery, honoring the words.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫様をかわいらしいと褒め続けてらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, you never stopped saying how wonderful our grandchildren were, did you, dear?
lines.style: Tender, winding-down quality. Voice soft and close, like sitting beside him. The praise he gave becomes praise she's giving now — passing it forward. Trailing warmth at the close.
